verses.text: For the one directing. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. O YHWH our Lord, how majestic [is] Your name in all the earth, who have set Your splendor above the heavens!

segments.text: For the one directing. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. O YHWH our Lord, how majestic [is] Your name in all the earth, who have set Your splendor above the heavens!

verses.text: From the mouth of infants and sucklings You have established strength, on account of Your adversaries, to still the enemy and avenger.

segments.text: From the mouth of infants and sucklings You have established strength, on account of Your adversaries, to still the enemy and avenger.

verses.text: When I see Your heavens, the works of Your fingers, the moon and the stars that You have established—

segments.text: When I see Your heavens, the works of Your fingers, the moon and the stars that You have established—

verses.text: what [is] man that You should remember him, and the son of man, that You would attend to him?

segments.text: what [is] man that You should remember him, and the son of man, that You would attend to him?

verses.text: And You made him lacking a little from the angels, and with glory and honor You crowned him.

segments.text: And You made him lacking a little from the angels, and with glory and honor You crowned him.

verses.text: You made him to rule over the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:

segments.text: You made him to rule over the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:

verses.text: All sheep and cattle, and also the beasts of the field,

segments.text: All sheep and cattle, and also the beasts of the field,

verses.text: the birds of the heavens and the fish of the sea, those passing [on] the paths of the seas.

segments.text: the birds of the heavens and the fish of the sea, those passing [on] the paths of the seas.

verses.text: O YHWH, our Lord, how majestic [is] Your name in all the earth!

segments.text: O YHWH, our Lord, how majestic [is] Your name in all the earth!
